laz-perf 0.0.7 (Apache-2.0, https://github.com/hobuinc/laz-perf), from npm. LICENSE = the repository's COPYING.
laz-perf.wasm = the package's lib/web/laz-perf.wasm, unchanged.
laz-perf.js = esbuild bundle (--bundle --format=esm --minify) of the package's web build (lib/web/laz-perf.js, an
Emscripten MODULARIZE factory) behind a small ES-module wrapper:
  import create from 'laz-perf/lib/web/laz-perf.js';
  export default function createLazPerf(opts = {}) { return create({ locateFile: (p) => new URL(p, import.meta.url).href, ...opts }); }
so the .wasm is fetched from next to this file (pass `wasmBinary` to skip the fetch, as the Node tests do). No workers.
Used by CivilCraft (las.js) — loaded only when a .laz file is read.
